archetypes.name: dyn-topology-rule
archetypes.rationale: Checks the moved topology constraints remain complete and scoped.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the topology-generation rule changes and the deleted CI-fix reference. Confirm the composition and value constraints were preserved without duplicating unrelated CI guidance. Check that topology rule frontmatter stayed intact and remains compatible with the topology-rule-paths lint. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-focus-enum
archetypes.rationale: Checks focus-area lint surfaces after deleting an enum prompt file.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the focus-area prompt deletion and the matching updates in python/voting.py and .github/workflows/ci.yaml. Confirm the checked file lists remain in sync and no missing-file lint path remains. Look for any other tracked references to the deleted focus-area prompt. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
